results.name: Flood in northern Bosnia-Herzegovina
results.reason: On 27 March 2025 at 15:00, a flood was forecast to hit areas in Northern Bosnia-Herzegovina. The event was expected to peak in the following days. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping was requested to provide an initial rough estimation and flood extent emergency mapping.
results.activator: Bosnia and Herzegovina|Protection and Rescue Sector - Operational and Communication Center BiH - 112
